plan: In a seaside diving lodge equipment room at bright noon, leaning lightly on a dry wooden bench to inspect a pair of clear diving goggles, one hand holds the strap loosely while the other opens beside the lens. Turquoise reflected water light, yellow lockers without lettering.
Fully lined lemon-yellow bikini with secure wide-strapped square-neck top and high-waisted green bottoms, open short white linen cover shirt, bare arms midriff and legs, tiny leaf hair clip.

In an elevated berry orchard walkway at dawn, reaching one arm up to check a ripe fruit cluster while the other hand rests open on the rail, both feet planted. Cool mist and warm sun strips, full head hands and shoes visible.
Sleeveless brown canvas short overalls over a green fitted cropped tank, yellow waist tie and flat garden shoes, bare shoulders waist sides and legs, small leaf enamel pin.

Inside a small home record-listening nook on a rainy afternoon, seated on a chair and using a soft record brush on a vinyl disc on the table, hands well separated. Amber lamp and rain-speckled window, head torso and complete hands inside crop.
Cream off-shoulder ribbed knit top with elbow sleeves and a green wrap skirt below crop, exposed shoulders and narrow waist, small leaf necklace.
